title: #[non_exhaustive] on CredentialStoreError and all ConfigErrors is correct
description: CredentialStoreError, and ConfigError in imap/reader/smtp all received #[non_exhaustive]. This is the correct choice: new error variants can be added in patches without breaking callers who match on the enum. Do not remove #[non_exhaustive] to simplify pattern matching — that would lock the error surface.
